Regla: cada forma del nombre, cada titulo y cada perfil llevan la fuente que lo midio; lo que no existe se declara en notFound en vez de rellenarse. Sin biografia: NEXUS comprobo con cuatro metodos independientes que no hay ninguna recuperable.

knownTitles.title: Cited or Invisible: The GEO/AEO Playbook for Clinics and Medical Practices
knownTitles.corroboration: ASIN B0GX2VKG28. Three things hold this title up, and they are not the same kind of evidence. (1) It was declared in writing by the owner of this catalog on 2026-09-25T13:48:53Z — a statement by the publisher of the book, not a reading of the Amazon listing, and it is not cited as one. (2) It is corroborated by a measurement: in a search-result file RADAR had already paid for and saved (SerpApi, created_at 2026-09-25 02:18:27 UTC), result 6 of 9 is https://www.amazon.ca/Cited-Invisible-Playbook-Clinics-Practices-ebook/dp/B0GX2VKG28 with the snippet "Cited or Invisible: The GEO/AEO Playbook for Clinics and Medical Practices eBook : CL, Metrilab: Amazon.ca: Kindle Store" — the ASIN and the exact title together in one Kindle-store URL. That result was found by VERITAS on 2026-09-25T02:49:10Z, confirmed independently by ATLAS at 2026-09-25T13:50Z, and re-read from the same file by TALLER at 2026-09-25T14:00:51Z. (3) The Amazon product page of this ASIN has never been readable: eight requests on 2026-09-25 — five by EXPLORADOR with metrilab-render between 01:50:31Z and 02:03:20Z, three by CEREBRO with curl at 13:35:15Z, 13:36:02Z and 13:47:44Z — returned either nothing at all (four responses of 0 bytes) or an http=200 whose entire body is Amazon's automated-access notice (one of 2656 bytes, three of 3781 bytes). The 2656-byte one states that continued access by an unauthorized AI agent violates Amazon's Conditions of Use. All eight saved responses were re-measured by TALLER on 2026-09-25T14:02:00Z: not one of them contains the product-title element of an Amazon product page. So no attribute of the book — length, date, price, language — is published or guessed. The short form "Cited Or Invisible" is also listed on the Goodreads author profile (read 2026-09-25T02:15:35Z), and the same work is listed on amazon.ae under ASIN B0H8H2T1C1: another marketplace, not a competing identity. In that same search file three booksellers list the work under ISBN 9798186753063, which belongs to the paperback edition and not to this ASIN.

notFound: No biography anywhere. The Goodreads profile is the only third-party profile found and its author-info block contains no text — no biography, no website, no external link of any kind. Checked by MetrilabCL / MET-151 (NEXUS) on 2026-09-25 with four independent methods.
No Wikidata item. Two queries ("Metrilab" and "MetrilabCL") returned zero results on 2026-09-25T02:15:00Z.
No press coverage. GDELT returns zero articles for the exact byline "Metrilab Cl" across online media since 2015 (query answered 2026-09-25T02:16:37Z).

No social or professional profile (LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook) and no website of the publisher was found by any of the methods used. Not found is not the same as does not exist: it means no method tried revealed one.

No Amazon author page to link to. On all three measured listings the byline links to a search-results URL (/s/ref=dp_byline_sr_ebooks_1?field-author=...), not to an author entity page, so there is no stable Amazon page for this author to point at. Read from the saved Amazon HTML by MetrilabCL / MET-156 (TALLER) on 2026-09-25T02:42Z for B0FP1RY9G4 and B0HDPV63R4, and by MET-166 (TALLER) on 2026-09-25T13:54:39Z for B0H28T65JL, whose saved page contains zero links to an author entity.

No ratings and no reviews. The three measured Amazon listings and the Goodreads profile all show zero: on the third, a literal search over its saved HTML for "out of 5", "customer review", the review-count element of an Amazon listing and the structured-data property that carries an average rating returns zero matches each (TALLER, MET-166, 2026-09-25T13:54:43Z). Nothing is aggregated on this site because there is nothing to aggregate.

No organization. No company entity with verifiable contact details exists in any source measured, so this page describes the byline as it is published and does not invent an address, a phone number or a founding date.
